changes.comment: When the daemon cannot load a project's configuration, for example after a filtered install left the rig package of an unselected project uninstalled, it hands each request to in-process Rush with a one-line reason instead of rejecting every build, and writes the full error to the daemon log. A missing shrinkwrap-deps.json is still rejected, because in-process Rush cannot build without it either, with Rush's "rush install" instruction as the last line.
